column3: Fastest: travel to Tyras Camp and take the path north-east. Cross the stick trap and dig beside the stone at the far side of the pool.
Fastest: from the Observatory go east towards Tree Gnome Village. Find the lone willow by the river and dig on its south-west side.
Fastest: from the general store walk west to the two ponds and dig on the narrow strip between them.
Fastest: use the Karamja lodestone. Walk to the dungeon entrance south-west of Brimhaven and dig just south of it, outside.
Fastest: from Lumbridge Castle head into the swamp to the adventurers' camp where Lost City starts. Dig within the camp.
Fastest: from Port Sarim go south-west past the church on the way to the ice cave. Dig near the cave entrance on the surface.
Fastest: from Lumbridge go south into the swamp to the Nexus. Stand one tile north of its northern pillar and dig.
Fastest: use fairy ring DKP, then head north towards the fishing shore. Dig on the seaweed where Tiadeche fishes.
Fastest: from the Tirannwn lodestone take the north-west trail over the leaf trap. Turn south-west to the stick trap and check the marked square beyond it.

column2: Moss Giant Island, west of Brimhaven
column3: Fastest: go to Brimhaven's west coast. Cross the agility obstacle to the moss giants and dig on the high ground in the middle of the island.
Fastest: go east from Yanille to the coastal islands. Reach the island with jungle spiders and dig at the highlighted position.
Fastest: from Al Kharid travel north-east into Het's Oasis. Find Het's statue in the centre and dig on its north side.

column2: Willows north of the Necromancer's Tower
column3: Fastest: head south from East Ardougne towards the tower. Find three willows and dig on the north-east side of the group.
Fastest: from Draynor Village follow the road towards the jail. Dig outside, to the north-east of the building.
Fastest: leave Yanille to the south. North-east of the crystal tree, look for three bushes arranged in a triangle and dig on their west side.
Fastest: from the Karamja lodestone travel south to the gleaming wisp colony. Dig west of the rift, immediately north of the tree.

column2: South-west side of the Karamja divination colony
column3: Fastest: travel south from the Karamja lodestone to the gleaming wisps. Go around the rift to its south-west side.
Fastest: travel to Bedabin Camp in the Kharidian Desert. On the pond's north bank, dig in the gap between the two trees.

column2: Mine by the Nature altar, Karamja
column3: Fastest: from Shilo Village head north towards the Nature altar. Enter the nearby mining area and dig in the middle.
Fastest: from Yanille take the route south into Gu'Tanoth. Follow the bridges through the city and dig near the tree beyond the last bridge.
Fastest: enter the cave south of Gu'Tanoth's south-west corner. It takes you onto the island. Dig at the break in the stakes on the eastern edge.
Fastest: reach Crandor and follow the island to the runite rocks in the north-east. Dig five tiles east of the eastern rock.
Fastest: use the Port Sarim lodestone and charter a ship to the Shipyard. Walk west to G.L.O. Caranock's building and dig outside its east window.
Fastest: follow Arandar Pass to the red spiders' eggs. Dig one square north of the southernmost egg spawn.
Fastest: head to the plain rock mine in the Feldip Hills. Dig at the northernmost rockslide.
Fastest: go south through Mort Myre Swamp to the Nature Spirit's grotto. Dig behind the grotto tree.
Fastest: go north from the windmill to the river crossing south of the Champions' Guild. Dig beside the bridge.
Fastest: go west from Shilo Village to the coast. Cross the bridge to Cairn Isle, then follow the marker on the island.

column2: West side of the Desert Bandit Camp
column3: Fastest: use the Bandit Camp lodestone. Head to the western edge of the camp and dig between the shore and the cactus.
Fastest: go to the river crossing used to reach the Jungle Forester. Dig on the north side of the stepping stones.

column2: Lakes south-west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold
column3: Fastest: leave the stronghold towards its south-western lakes. Dig between the two eastern ponds.
Fastest: enter the swamp from Canifis. Go south past the two fishing spots to the next pond and look for the rotten tree.
Fastest: from the Taverley lodestone go to the wheat field beside the dungeon entrance. Dig immediately south of the scarecrow.
Fastest: head south-west from the Taverley gate to the lake. Dig by the Lady of the Lake.

column2: Hemenster, north-east of the Fishing Guild
column3: Fastest: from the Fishing Guild head north-east towards Hemenster. Dig on the marked ground south of the village.
Fastest: enter the Kharazi Jungle south of Shilo Village. Find the pool used during Legends' Quest and dig at its southern edge.

column2: Third pond in Mort Myre Swamp
column3: Fastest: enter through the swamp gate near Canifis. Follow the ponds south to the third and dig on the indicated bank.
Fastest: enter the Herblore Habitat and go to the south-west tree. Dig on its east side.
Fastest: from Shilo Village enter the jungle and go to its south-western coast. Dig beside the corpse on the small peninsula.

Fastest: Ctrl+T or ;;t > Skilling > Agility > Gnome Course, then walk west along the south side of the stronghold to the terrorbird pen. Dig near the water by its eastern gate. Alternatively: Amulet of farming > Trees > Gnome Stronghold patches, then go north-west to the same gate.
Fastest: use the Eagles' Peak lodestone. Go south-west to the path that climbs the mountain and dig at the bottom.
Fastest: bring a rope and reach the second waterfall island. Dig at the dead tree near the edge.

column2: Ice Mountain, south of the Oracle
column3: Fastest: from Edgeville travel west to Ice Mountain. Find the pair of trees south of the Oracle and dig between them.
Fastest: from Canifis head north-west towards the Slayer Tower. At the last torch before the fence, count six north and four east, then dig.

column2: Swamps north-west of the Grand Tree
column3: Fastest: go to the north-west side of the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Dig on the ground between the two swampy patches.
Fastest: use the Burthorpe lodestone. Find the building immediately south of the agility course and dig by the hay outside.
Fastest: use the Edgeville Dungeon route past the black demons. Climb the Air Obelisk ladder into the Wilderness and dig three tiles east of it.
Fastest: travel north from Edgeville to the dead trees around the bronze-arrow spawn. Dig just east of the arrows.
Fastest: use the Fremennik Province lodestone. Head into the forest east of Rellekka and dig two squares west of the swaying tree.
Fastest: travel to the summit of Trollheim. Dig immediately south of Mad Eadgar's cave entrance.
Fastest: take the mountain path to the Troll Stronghold. Dig on the south side of the entrance.
Fastest: go to the ruined buildings west of the Wilderness Bandit Camp. Enter the ruins and follow the marked tile.

column2: Lava pools north-east of the Boneyard
column3: Fastest: head north from the black salamanders to the three pools in level 22 Wilderness. Dig between the lava pools.

column2: Rock crab shore, north-east of Rellekka
column3: Fastest: from Rellekka follow the coast north-east to the rock crabs. Dig on the seaweed east of the dock.

column2: Ruins north of the Graveyard of Shadows
column3: Fastest: reach the ruins in level 28 Wilderness. Find the steel platelegs and the trapdoor and dig between them.
Fastest: go to the central row of graves in the Forgotten Cemetery. Dig in front of the broken gravestone.
Fastest: start at the big bones in the area and head north towards the chaos dwarves. Use the marked square among the rocks.

column2: Moss giants west of Red Dragon Isle
column3: Fastest: find the pond among the moss giants in level 36 Wilderness. Dig on the north side of the water.
Fastest: head to the north-east part of the mine in level 36 Wilderness. Dig on the little rise.
Fastest: find the altar in level 38 Wilderness. Go outside to the south-west corner of its building and dig.
Fastest: travel to the fenced lesser demons in the Wilderness. Dig at the indicated tile inside the enclosure.
Fastest: Ring of wealth > Miscellania, then find the mine and smithing area and follow the path just south of it to its end.

column2: Runite rocks north of the Lava Maze
column3: Fastest: head to the runite rocks in level 46 Wilderness. Dig two tiles west of the eastern rock.
Fastest: reach the ruins and find the red pentagrams on the ground. Dig on the north-eastern pentagram.
Fastest: enter Rogues' Castle in level 53 Wilderness. Dig at the north-east corner inside the castle.
Fastest: use the Ardougne lever and go north from the keep, through the web. Continue to the marked ground by the bones.
Fastest: go around the back of the pirates' building. Dig one square west of the back door.

column2: West side of the Wilderness Agility Course
column3: Fastest: follow the western boundary of the course north. Dig near the fence at the northern end.

column2: Axe hut, north-east of the Mage Arena
column3: Fastest: go around the hut in level 56 Wilderness. Dig immediately west of its rear door.
Fastest: from the Bandit Camp lodestone travel east and slightly north towards Pollnivneach. Dig at the pin on the surface map.
Fastest: from Burthorpe head to the cave near the Death Plateau path. Enter and talk to Sabbot.
Fastest: Ancient spellbook > Lassar Teleport (Ice Mountain), then enter the mine. Alternatively: Falador lodestone, run north to the mines, go down the ladder and follow the mine to the chest.
Fastest: enter the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Look for Brimstail's cave in the south-west corner and speak to him inside.
Fastest: use the Falador lodestone, go south to the castle and cross the bridge. Talk to Squire Asrol in the courtyard.
Fastest: from Edgeville go west to the monastery and speak to Abbot Langley.
Fastest: use the Port Sarim lodestone and enter Gerrant's fishing shop. Speak to Gerrant.

column2: Exam Centre, south of the Dig Site
column3: Fastest: head south from the Dig Site to the Exam Centre and speak to an examiner.
Fastest: from the Barbarian Outpost head south to the house beside the falls. Climb upstairs and search the boxes.
Fastest: take Pirate Pete's boat to Braindeath Island. Follow the bridges and climb to the stagnant pool. Dig on its west side.
Fastest: go to the waterfront on the west side of the Worker district and speak to Hamid.
Fastest: find the rug merchant at Nardah. Go west to the large cactus and dig on its west side.
Fastest: go to the agility course inside the Tree Gnome Stronghold and speak to the trainer.

column2: Mine carts in the Dwarven Mine
column3: Fastest: enter the Dwarven Mine from Ice Mountain or Falador. Go east to the coal rocks and search the northern mine cart.

column2: Sorcerer's Tower, south of Seers' Village
column3: Fastest: travel south from Seers' Village to the Sorcerer's Tower. Go upstairs and search the north-wall bookcase.
Fastest: from Draynor Village cross the bridge south to the tower. Search the south-west bookcase on the ground floor.
Fastest: enter the Grand Tree. On the level above the ground floor, speak to Heckel Funch.
Fastest: travel to Lletya, enter the general store and search its crate.
Fastest: climb down the rope in Karamja Volcano. Find the red spiders' eggs and dig on their spawn.
Fastest: travel east across the Kharidian Desert to Uzer. Look west of the Golem quest start and search the boxes.
Fastest: enter the sewers through the manhole east of Varrock Palace. Follow the tunnels to the moss giants and dig by the bubbling cauldron.

column2: Karamja gnome glider, Captain Klemfoodle's fire
column3: Fastest: travel to the gnome glider landing site on Karamja. Find Captain Klemfoodle beside the glider and dig on his campfire.
Fastest: enter the zoo in southern East Ardougne. Dig beside the torch between the scorpion and penguin pens.
Fastest: go north from the Barbarian Outpost towards the stepping stones. Dig on the westernmost small shell.
Fastest: enter the agility dungeon by Yanille. Use the Chaos altar route to the lower floor. Search the crates in the poison spider area.
Fastest: head south from East Ardougne to the tower. Go upstairs and search the drawers.

column2: Broken multicannon near the Coal Trucks
column3: Fastest: follow the track to the Dwarf Cannon site. Search the boxes against the outside north wall of the building with the broken cannon.
Fastest: use the Lumbridge lodestone and go west into the castle kitchen. Climb down the trapdoor. Search the crate in the south-east corner of the cellar.
Fastest: use the Bandit Camp lodestone. Enter the general store and search the crates inside.
Fastest: enter the workshop through the wall in the smithy west of the bank. Downstairs, search the crate east of the central hatch towards the air room.
Fastest: go north of Ardougne Castle to Jimmy Dazzler's house. Search the drawers on the left in its north-west corner.
Fastest: go to the witch's house and find its south window. Stand outside the window, south of the cauldron, and dig.
Fastest: go downstairs in Varrock west bank. Dig in front of the gate by the ruby ring.
Fastest: from the Fremennik Province lodestone enter Rellekka and find Swensen the Navigator's house. Search the crate inside.
Fastest: follow the path up White Wolf Mountain to the glider and speak to its gnome pilot.
Fastest: use the Lumbridge lodestone and go west to the castle. Talk to Hans as he walks around the castle.
Fastest: enter Lumbridge Castle and climb one flight of stairs. Find the spinning wheel and search the drawers in that room.
Fastest: from Varrock Square go north into the palace. Speak to Sir Prysin on the ground floor.
Fastest: go north-west from Lumbridge to the flour mill. Climb to the top and search the crate.
Fastest: find the fur stall in central Varrock and speak to Wilough nearby.
Fastest: use the Edgeville lodestone. Walk north to Oziach's armour shop and speak to him.
Fastest: find the two yews near the ruined building. Dig one tile east of the southern yew.
Fastest: take the monks' boat from Port Sarim to Entrana. Find the house with the glassblowing pipe and search the drawers on the south wall.
Fastest: go to the church east of the furnace. Climb its south-west ladder and search the crate in the tower.
Fastest: walk to the Port Sarim waterfront and speak to Captain Tobias.
Fastest: get the chest key from a monk at the monastery south of Ardougne. Search the chest in the chapel north of Varrock Museum.
Fastest: go to the tent beside the bank marker north-east of Het's Oasis. Speak to Jeed.
Fastest: obtain the key from a Zamorak monk at the temple south of Goblin Village. Search the drawers on the north-east side of Edgeville Monastery.
Fastest: kill a spellwisp outside the north-west side of the tower for its key. Take the key upstairs to the marked cupboard.
Fastest: head south from Brimhaven to Tai Bwo Wannai. Search the crates beneath the raised hut shown on the map.
Fastest: from the Karamja lodestone head north to Lubufu on the shore. Search the crate by his fishing spot.
Fastest: get the key from a guard dog outside Handelmort Mansion. Cross to the tavern west of the river, go upstairs and search the drawers.
Fastest: from Witchaven take Holgart's or Jeb's boat to the fishing platform. Search the crate inside the shack.
Fastest: Ctrl+T or ;;t > Locations > Zanaris. Walk to the furnace in the north-west of the city and search the crates. Alternatively: a fairy ring to Zanaris, or the Lumbridge Swamp shed.
Fastest: head north from Het's Oasis to the arena. Go upstairs and search the bookcase in the north-east corner.
Fastest: use the Canifis lodestone. Enter the clothing shop and search its crates.
Fastest: look west of the Fishing Guild and south of the falls for Hadley's round building. Search the bales of hay inside.
Fastest: reach Karamja's banana plantation and follow the shore north to the dock with three rowboats. Search the middle crate.
Fastest: use the Burthorpe lodestone and go north to the houses. Enter the house at the pin and search its drawers.

column2: Seers' Village house south of the anvil
column3: Fastest: find the smithy in Seers' Village. Go to the house immediately south of it and check the drawers for the key clue.
Fastest: go south from West Ardougne to the battlefield. Search the crates outside its north-eastern building near the small obelisk.
Fastest: find the anvil building in Port Khazard. Stand immediately outside its door and dig.
Fastest: enter Sophanem and go to the pyramid. Search the crates south-west of the Pyramid Plunder entrance.
Fastest: go to the village well in Pollnivneach and dig alongside it.
Fastest: go to the Dig Site north of the Archaeology Guild. Descend the winch leading to Doug Deeping and search the sacks underground.
Fastest: enter the Ranging Guild and find the northern archery shop. Search the nearby crate.
Fastest: enter the ogre settlement south of Yanille. Find the rock cake stall and dig between the rocks in front.
Fastest: get a key from a pirate in the nearby bar. Go upstairs in the house with the cooking range and search the drawers.
Fastest: head south from Port Sarim towards the fairy ring on Mudskipper Point. Dig on the starfish south of the ring.
Fastest: enter the camp in the Kharidian Desert. Find the cart by the camel and search the crate to its south.
Fastest: Ctrl+T (or ;;t) > Skilling > Construction > Sawmill. Alternatively: Fort Forinthry lodestone. Then dig in the western shed at the Odd Old Man's camp.
Fastest: from the north gate go west to the bridge. Cross towards the south bank and dig by the spotted mushroom.
Fastest: walk east from the Brimhaven bar into the neighbouring house. Search its cupboard.
Fastest: get the key from a barbarian in Barbarian Village. At the Exam Centre search the chest in the southern room with the dragon head.
Fastest: go north-west from Seers' Village bank to the end of the coal tracks. Search the crate against the north wall.
Fastest: get the key from a market guard in Rellekka. Go upstairs in the Lighthouse and search the drawers by the bed.
Fastest: Amulet of farming > Bushes > Ardougne. Alternatively: fairy ring DJP. Then search the crates in the monks' building.

column2: House north of Yanille Wizards' Guild
column3: Fastest: get the key from the man downstairs in the house north of the guild. Climb the stairs and search the chest.
Fastest: walk west out of Witchaven to the temple entrance and descend. Search the chest against the first room's south wall.

column2: Broken cart west of the Outpost
column3: Fastest: head south-west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold to the Outpost. Go west to the damaged cart and search the crates.
Fastest: travel to the spiders in level 46 Wilderness. Find the sapphire spawn and dig beneath it.

column2: Quarry south of the Desert Bandit Camp
column3: Fastest: head south from the camp into the sandstone quarry. Find the wheelbarrow and dig by the marked side of it.
Fastest: enter the Observatory. Search the crate immediately north of the stairs leading down.
Fastest: pull the Wilderness lever in East Ardougne. Dig at the arrival spot in front of the return lever.
Fastest: get a key from an Ardougne guard. Go upstairs in Jerico's house east of the river and search the drawers.
Fastest: go to the Wilderness graveyard and look for the ground spawn of a crossbow. Pick it up and dig there.
Fastest: head south of the port towards the church near the ice dungeon. Dig just outside its west wall.
Fastest: take the boat to Miscellania and go east onto Etceteria. Dig at the crossroads.
Fastest: enter Shilo Village and go to the antiques shop. Search the bookcase on its west wall.
Fastest: enter Burthorpe Castle and go downstairs to the games room. Stand in the centre and perform the requested emote.

column2: Dwarven tunnel under White Wolf Mountain
column3: Fastest: take the underground passage between Taverley and Catherby. Find Captain Ninto in the dwarven bar.
Fastest: enter Keldagrim and cross to the eastern side. Find the sculptor's model Riki and speak to him.
Fastest: enter the Wizards' Guild in Yanille and go down to the cellar. Speak to Wizard Frumscone.
Fastest: Ctrl+T or ;;t > Locations > Zanaris. Fairy Nuff is north of the bank. Alternatively: a fairy ring to Zanaris, or the Lumbridge Swamp shed.
Fastest: go to Rantz in the eastern Feldip Hills. Enter his cave and speak to Fycie.
Fastest: reach the Tree Gnome Stronghold and enter the cave in the south-west corner. Talk to Brimstail.
Fastest: go to the goblin buildings just north-east of the Observatory. Search the crate in the group of three buildings.
Fastest: enter Yanille and find the building with the anvil. Dig at the south-east wall shown on the map.

column2: Picnic tables south of the Legends' Guild
column3: Fastest: from the guild entrance walk south towards the picnic tables and dig two tiles south of the northern bench.
Fastest: enter West Ardougne and find the ruined building marked on the street map. Dig in its north-west corner.

column2: Clock Tower, south of East Ardougne
column3: Fastest: go to the Clock Tower south of Ardougne. Search the crate beside the nearby bridge.
Fastest: go west from Seers' Village and enter through the loose northern fence. Search the crate south of the hut.
Fastest: enter the Wilderness fortress west of the black unicorns. Search the crate in the courtyard.
Fastest: head north-east from Varrock towards the former Lumber Yard and follow the marker to the crate by the wall.
Fastest: from the Khazard Battlefield follow the path towards Ourania. Dig immediately behind the chaos altar.

column2: South side of the Wizards' Tower
column3: Fastest: fairy ring DIS, or Ctrl+T (or ;;t) > Locations > Wizards' Tower, then run south around the tower and dig east of the rock.
Fastest: use the Seers' Village lodestone. Follow the coal tracks west to the river crossing. Dig just outside the door of Galahad's house.
Fastest: walk west through Rimmington towards the coast. Go to the west side of the chemist's house and dig.
Fastest: travel by boat to Miscellania and find the sign at the end of the path. Dig between the sign and the evergreen.
Fastest: go south from East Ardougne towards the Tower of Life. Find the large head by the road and dig to its south.
Fastest: go north of Falador's Party Room, outside the city wall. Dig west of the tree in the enclosure of standing stones.
Fastest: use the Falador lodestone and run north to the statue at the crossroads. Dig one tile south and three east of the statue.
Fastest: head south-east from Varrock to the mine. At the end of the path dig two tiles south-east of the dead tree.

column2: Road from Seers' Village to Rellekka
column3: Fastest: head north from the Seers' Village lodestone along the road towards Rellekka. Dig beside the bush at the bend.

Fastest: Ctrl+T or ;;t > Skilling > Crafting > Crafting Guild, then go west onto the Hobgoblin Peninsula and dig at its tip (marked on the map). Alternatively: Falador lodestone, then run south-west through Falador and west from the Crafting Guild onto the peninsula tip.
Fastest: go east of the Wilderness Agility Course to the craters. Find the large geyser and dig two tiles west.

column2: Crystal tree island west of Rellekka
column3: Fastest: look for the small island on the map west of Rellekka. Follow the branching path to the crystal tree and dig.
Fastest: enter the swamp south of Canifis. Find the mushroom shown on the map and dig four tiles west of it.
Fastest: go to the willow trees by the fishing spots. Dig between the southernmost willow and the small obelisk.

column2: River west of the Champions' Guild
column3: Fastest: go south-west from Varrock to the river near the guild. Dig three tiles east of the tree opposite the small island.
Fastest: from the Seers' Village lodestone head south-west to the Ranging Guild, east of Hemenster. Enter the guild and search the large haystack by the southern fence.

column2: Search the crates in the yard of Citharede Abbey
column3: Fastest: press Ctrl+T (or type ;;t), then choose Slayer > Desert Strykewyrms and walk to the abbey. Alternatively, teleport to the Al Kharid lodestone and head east. Search the crates in the abbey yard.

Fastest: teleport to the Yanille lodestone and run east to Port Khazard, then search the crate near the cart. Alternatively: Lunar spellbook Khazard Teleport, or fairy ring DJP (Tower of Life) if it is on Kavros, or an amulet of farming to the Ardougne bush patch.
Fastest: Ctrl+T (or ;;t) > Skilling > Smithing > Artisan's Workshop, then walk to the chainmail shop and search the drawers. Alternatively: Falador lodestone and head south.
Fastest: fairy ring CJR, then walk to Sinclair Mansion and speak to Louisa in the side room south-west of the hall. Alternatively: Seers' Village lodestone, then north-east to the mansion.

Fastest: type ;;ig (Invention Guild), leave the guild and run north-west to Doric's house (it stands north of Falador, a little west of the Falador lodestone). Alternatively: Ctrl+T (or ;;t) > Skilling > Summoning > Taverley, then head east.
Fastest: Ctrl+T (or ;;t) > Skilling > Smithing > Artisan's Workshop, then walk to the house and search the crates. Alternatively: Falador lodestone and head south-east.
Fastest: Ctrl+T (or ;;t) > Skilling > Smithing > Artisan's Workshop, walk to the house, take the stairs up one floor and search the chests.
Fastest: Ctrl+T (or ;;t) > Skilling > Summoning > Taverley, then walk to Ivy's house and search the drawers.
Fastest: Modern spellbook > Ardougne Teleport, then walk to the armour shop and search the crates outside.
Fastest: Amulet of farming > Trees > Varrock, then walk to the cart and search the crates.
Fastest: Modern spellbook > Camelot Teleport, then walk into the castle courtyard and speak to Sir Kay.
Fastest: Combat bracelet > Ranging Guild, then walk to the building in Hemenster and search the crate.
Fastest: Ctrl+T (or ;;t) > Skilling > Smithing > Artisan's Workshop, then walk to the Party Room and talk to Party Pete.
Fastest: Ctrl+T (or ;;t) > Skilling > Agility > Gnome Course, then head north-west and speak to a referee. Alternatively: Amulet of farming > Trees > Gnome Stronghold patches.
Fastest: Ctrl+T (or ;;t) > Skilling > Agility > Barbarian Course. The course lands at the clue. Cheer, then headbang.
